summary: Small asphalt car park at the Mount Coot-tha summit, bush behind, no homes.
reasons: No dwellings; cafe and restaurant only

best_section.where: Northern bays along the bush edge of the summit car park, below the cafe

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind on the north and west; nearest buildings are the summit cafe and restaurant, 15 m and more, none are homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park off Sir Samuel Griffith Drive with marked bays and room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Tourist lookout; visitors come and go, but nobody lives close.
drivers.convention: Mapped public car park with no fee; the no stopping, bus and loading signs are on the road edge, not in the bays.

flags: Busy tourist spot; people around the lookout
Signs: No Stopping and bus zone at the entrance, loading zone on the road
Steep road edge: DEM shows up to 21% at the bank, car park itself about 1 to 2%
Possibly lit and patrolled; cannot tell
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees on the north side shade the northern bays at midday.
cannot_judge: Time limits or overnight rules on site
